greeting.description: Controls the greeting a caller hears before leaving a voicemail. Set `mode` to `default` to play the standard system greeting, or to `custom_greeting` to play your own audio. When `mode` is `custom_greeting`, `media_name` is required and must reference an audio file already uploaded to your account through the Media Storage API.

media_name.description: The name of the media file to play as the greeting. Required when `mode` is `custom_greeting`; ignored when `mode` is `default`. The value must match the `media_name` of a file you previously uploaded with the Media Storage API (`POST /v2/media`).

mode.description: The greeting mode. `default` plays the standard system greeting. `custom_greeting` plays the audio referenced by `media_name`.

pin.description: The pin used for the voicemail.

Payment.description: Machine Payment Protocol credential used on paid retries, sent as `Authorization: Payment ...`. Obtained by paying a challenge returned in the `WWW-Authenticate` header of a 402 response. This is not a Telnyx API key; initial challenge requests use standard bearer authentication instead.

get.description: Returns the voicemail settings for a phone number

parameters.description: The ID of the phone number.

patch.description: Update voicemail settings for a phone number. You can also configure a custom greeting by setting the `greeting` object: use `mode` `custom_greeting` together with a `media_name` that points to an audio file uploaded through the Media Storage API, or `mode` `default` to use the standard system greeting.

post.description: Create voicemail settings for a phone number. You can also configure a custom greeting by setting the `greeting` object: use `mode` `custom_greeting` together with a `media_name` that points to an audio file uploaded through the Media Storage API, or `mode` `default` to use the standard system greeting.
